actual_scope: Count complete M in GL_n(F2) giving common I_d pivots and Schur-commutator rank 2d for any fixed commuting idempotent pair, using its joint-sector dimensions; give unconditional and identity-pivot-conditioned densities.
scope_change_reason: Handoff-first selection of PR4671's explicit count question. This is a written algebraic counting side theorem with exact corroboration, not a Lean formalization, another dimension construction or a selected-caller audit.
bottleneck_link: Quantifies the frequency of a maximal one-block Schur transition in the complete-header ensemble. It does not establish full-guard-chain densities, production-header feasibility, physical cost savings, supplier admission or a new kappa.
stop_rule: Stop after the one-block formula and discriminating exact examples. Keep dimension work closed; do not automatically extend to full-guard recursion or physical implementation.
evidence: README gives the exact factor and header counts with proofs. verify.py independently enumerates 270759 matrix-factor pairs, 60648 small header/context cases, both 496-element scalar split domains, and all 241920 positive complete-header cases, distinct for each fixed pair. Seven semantic/domain rejection controls are included.

family_decision.contract: Fixed commuting binary idempotent pair; uniform complete GL_n header; one common leading d-block equal to I; count maximal Schur-commutator rank and both denominators.
family_decision.proved: Written six-map criterion (credited), elementary factor counts, complete-header completion bijection and count formula; exact finite corroboration.
family_decision.unknown: Restricted production covers; header selection/emission; physical reads; owned/borrowed state; dirty compensation/restoration; stock; dispatch; later guards and complete consumer bill. Unknown costs are not zero.
family_decision.decision_changed: Exact frequency of a maximal one-block transition; no claimed removal of paid work.
family_decision.comparison: Current Gaussian-gate follow-ups and PR4598/4599 full-guard counts concern different events. This is the separately specified PR4671 counting handoff.
family_decision.reopen_only: Named residual-state/ensemble question or actual caller contract with a full cost allowance.
